electronic_state_models.source: S2 X 3Sigma-g-minus: no first-order orbital SO centroid term. Rotational spin fine structure is not an atomic-J electronic ladder. https://doi.org/10.1021/acsearthspacechem.3c00116 . Ground spin only; higher electronic terms and second-order fine structure omitted.

Gas-phase IR/VUV photoionization: 255 +/- 4 cm-1, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0009261411008153 . Two Kramers components, g=2 each; RRHO electronic-level approximation, not a full Jahn-Teller vibronic partition function. Effective experimental centroid approximation: add -255/2 cm^-1 once to the scalar ANL energy; retain scalar anharmonic ZPE. This approximates coupled JT/SO dynamics; no separate JT correction is added.

Experimental ground-state A0=-376.835 cm-1: Milan et al., Chem. Phys. Lett. 239 (1995) 326-331, https://doi.org/10.1016/0009-2614(95)00488-2 . Electronic components only; rotational multiplicity is counted by the rotor. Experimental ground-term centroid approximation: add -376.835/2 cm^-1 once to the scalar ANL energy; retain scalar anharmonic ZPE.

Methyl X 2A2-double-prime, orbital nondegenerate; ground spin only. Neutral fragment term: Cole-Filipiak et al., JCP 138, 054301 (2013), https://bromine.cchem.berkeley.edu/grppub/xbeam15.pdf . No added first-order orbital SO correction.
Hydrogen 1s 2S1/2, L=0: no first-order orbital SO splitting. https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/Handbook/Tables/hydrogentable1.htm . Hyperfine structure is omitted.

CH2SH connectivity, nondegenerate ground doublet; do not transfer the CH3S 2E correction between isomers. Karaev et al., PCCP 26 (2024) 28939-28946, https://doi.org/10.1039/D4CP03906H . Ground spin only; no added first-order SO centroid correction.

CH3SS X 2A-double-prime (Cs), nondegenerate ground orbital state. Cole-Filipiak et al., JCP 138, 054301 (2013), https://bromine.cchem.berkeley.edu/grppub/xbeam15.pdf . Ground spin only; no added first-order SO centroid correction.

HSS X 2A-double-prime, nondegenerate ground orbital state. Tanimoto et al., J. Mol. Spectrosc. 199 (2000) 73-80, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10712872/ . Ground spin only; electronic A-X excitation is not a ground-term SO pair.

HSS localized bond representation, same H-S-S connectivity as [S]S; X 2A-double-prime. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10712872/ . Ground spin only; no added first-order orbital SO centroid correction. Identity is retained for saved QC.

CH2SSH connectivity, C1 equilibrium radical in the CH3S2 isomer study (Cheung, Li and Ng, THEOCHEM 339 (1995) 25-38, https://doi.org/10.1016/0166-1280(95)04154-X); structures reproduced in Fig. 1 of https://bromine.cchem.berkeley.edu/grppub/xbeam15.pdf . Nondegenerate doublet: no first-order orbital SO centroid term. Higher-order SO omitted.

CH2SHS connectivity (also reverse-order [S]S=C), C1 equilibrium radical in the CH3S2 isomer study, https://doi.org/10.1016/0166-1280(95)04154-X ; structures reproduced in Fig. 1 of https://bromine.cchem.berkeley.edu/grppub/xbeam15.pdf . Nondegenerate doublet: no first-order orbital SO centroid term. Higher-order SO omitted.
